certificate.description: The Cryptographic Primitives Library is a cryptographic module that provides cryptographic services to user-mode applications running on Windows through the set of exported functions described in section 3 Cryptographic Module Interfaces. The module includes a set of algorithm providers for the Cryptography Next Generation (CNG) framework in Windows. Each provider represents a single cryptographic algorithm or a set of closely related cryptographic algorithms.
